newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Bank plans cash tender offer for 2004 CB.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Bank plans cash tender offer for 2004 CB.

text.p: Sumitomo Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it will offer to purchase any and all of its 3.125 percent dollar-denominated convertible bonds maturing on March 31, 2004, through a cash tender offer.
Of the $300 million principle amount issued on January 30, 1989, $294.6 million remain outstanding as of September 30 this year, the bank said in a statement.
Sumitomo said that the offer was designed to strengthen its financial condition by trimming interest rate payments as well as its total debt.

Sumitomo will offer to buy for cash any and all of the outstanding bonds, together with all related unmatured coupons, at a price per $5,000 principal amount of the bonds to be determined as the tender price plus accrued interest from September 30, 1996 to, but not including, the payment date.
The offer date begins October 31, 1996 and ends December 10, 1996.

Sumitomo said that Lehman Brothers would act as dealer manager in connection with the offer, while Daiwa Europe Ltd, Goldman Sachs International and Sumitomo Finance International would act as tender agents.
